description: Returns the voted cross-references (OpenBible.info) of one verse, each with its reference and link; the first few also carry their English text. 12 by default (limit 1-30). Use when the user asks for the cross-references of one verse.

limit.description: how many results to return (1-30, default 12)

max_chars.description: optional: cap the answer at about this many characters (lists are shortened and marked truncated; use offset/nextOffset to get the rest)

name: get_cross_references
title: Cross-references
